name: Privacy.com
description: Create new Merchant-Locked and Single-Use virtual cards, manage card settings in bulk, and track your spending patterns directly from Claude. Leverage an AI-powered virtual card agent that helps you make changes programmatically and at scale—giving you deeper control over your payments with features like spend limits, card pausing, and closing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Privacy.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Privacy.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.privacy.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Privacy.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Privacy.com provides these MCP tools: get_card, get_pan, list_cards, list_transactions, close_card, create_card, pause_card, unpause_card, update_card_memo, and update_card_spend_limit.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Privacy.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Privacy.com in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Privacy.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Privacy.com is developed by Privacy.com. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
